reference: Too hard on yourself? After an awkward message, the replay can get harsh. In one experiment, people who took a kind, understanding view of something they regretted felt more motivated to make amends. In another, after failing a test, they studied longer. Kindness led to more effort, not less. So answer the replay kindly, then take one calm step, like a short apology. Take a mindful break with Mello.
